Terminated by express revocation. Later event: Executive Order 12987, signed 1996-01-31, amends section 1(a) by inserting "up to 20" in place of "15" in the second sentence; the clause continues, amended.

Section 1(b) directs the President to designate a Chairperson and Vice Chairperson from among the members. Terminated by express revocation. Section 3 of Executive Order 13062, signed September 29, 1997, ends its lead-in with "have terminated and whose work is completed, are revoked:"; item (b) reads "Executive Order 12964, as amended by Executive Orders 12987 and". Section 2(a) requires the Commission, on or before February 1, 1996, to report to the President on steps to open Japan, China and other Asian and Pacific markets to United States business, identify impediments and recommend ways to reduce them, and to recommend monitoring and measurement measures. These change the report date only; a report deadline is not an end, and the clause continues, amended.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register text of Executive Order 12964 (60 FR 33095, PDF pages 1-2 of the 1995-06-26 issue; sha256 0c095bc0...), headed Executive Order 12964 of June 21, 1995, Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy, matching the census register row (1995-06-21). Text and inventory: twelve scopes cover sections 1 through 4 to the signature; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory commission. Ending: Executive Order 13062 section 3(b) revokes Executive Order 12964, as amended by Executive Orders 12987 and 13032, effective September 30, 1997 (section 7). The report deadline in section 2(a) and the report-relative termination in section 4 are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.

savings.reason: Executive Order 13062 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy: its continuance sections concern other committees and its revocation section revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the body.
